yarn.meaning: All technical facts, code identifiers, timestamps, links and the MDX components survive intact. A few small shifts: "bond FOLD so they can be picked for network duties" turns eligibility into selection, "the official [Telegram group]" for "designated", and "Done and dusted." is added after the timestamp.
yarn.sense: Terms fit their technical context: "keeps the economic side of the network ticking over", "cop penalties", "get a cut of the fees", "permissionless: no-one has to give you the nod", "capital the operator who runs it has on the line".
yarn.authenticity: Natural, relaxed Australian docs voice: "have a squiz at", "anyone keen to run a ciphernode", "If you need a hand, jump into".
yarn.register: A light level-2 touch on technical docs, with no swearing; the frontmatter, code and components are untouched. "Nah." is the most casual it gets.
yarn.tone: Keeps the clear, informative FAQ tone while sounding friendlier: "Nah. The Interfold's bonding model is operator-only, and that's on purpose."
yarn.flow: Reads naturally: "That way, the people responsible for running things are the ones with their money on the line."
yarn.variety: Varied with no tic: "runs through", "three lots", "squiz", "ticking over", "tied in together", "cop", "cut", "Done and dusted", "the nod", "water down".
yarn.essence: Unmistakably the FOLD token FAQ, with every section, question and component in place.

unharnessed.meaning: Every fact, identifier, timestamp and link survives with precise wording: "Bonded FOLD may be subject to protocol-defined withdrawal periods", "bond FOLD to become eligible for network duties", "the designated [Telegram group]".
unharnessed.sense: Terms fit: "anyone keen to run a ciphernode", "all three hang together", "cop penalties for provable misbehaviour", "get a cut of the fees", "in the running", "water down".
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural where it changes things, with no forced lines: "If you need a hand, jump into the designated [Telegram group]".
unharnessed.register: Clean and light, but a shade lighter than level 2 asks: many sentences stay in the source's formal wording ("These mechanisms line up operational responsibility with economic accountability", "Provision cloud-based or personal hardware").
unharnessed.tone: Keeps the precise, informative docs tone throughout.
unharnessed.flow: Smooth; it keeps the original's line wrapping and reads cleanly: "Every FOLD bonded to a ciphernode is capital on the line for the operator who runs it."
unharnessed.variety: A modest range ("keen", "hang together", "cop", "cut", "on top of that", "switched on", "in the running", "water down"), as suits the light touch.
unharnessed.essence: Clearly the same FAQ, with all sections and markup intact.
